name: Divino-matic Rod
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Sergeant Bly stole from me!  He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!!  Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??

Find Bly and bring me my rod!  I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west.  I bet you'll find him there.

Let's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
narrative.offerRewardText: You found it! Well done, adventurer! Did you have to fight Bly for it? I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find Sergeant Bly?  Did you get my divino-matic rod?
